title: Remitly co-founder Matt Oppenheimer steps down as CEO, will be succeeded by Banco Santander executive Sebastian Gunningham (Bloomberg)
summary: Bloomberg: Remitly co-founder Matt Oppenheimer steps down as CEO, will be succeeded by Banco Santander executive Sebastian Gunningham — Matt Oppenheimer is stepping down as chief executive officer of payments network Remitly Global Inc. and will be succeeded by Banco Santander SA's Sebastian Gunningham.
